reviews.text: Came here in sleet weather, icy and slippery. We made it to gate #8. It was dark with low visibility. The staff were very helpful advising precaution and safety. Even though we didn’t see the far mountains but it was quite an adventure hiking on Great Wall in such weather.

This is the only section of the great wall that opens at night. Unlike the other sections, this part of the wall has not undergone as much reconstruction. So the steps can be pretty steep and uneven, and the ramparts are mostly gone so you don't have anything to hold onto on either side when you're climbing up/down. But it's totally worth it for this unique experience. Nothing really beats seeing the moon over the great wall at night. To come here, you need to purchase the tickets for both Gubei Watertown and the gondola. When we were there, the water town was a little crowded. But the wall was pretty empty when we got up.

Been to Mutianyu and Simatai. Both gives a different experience. If you liked a road less travelled, go for Simatai. It's the raw version of great wall. Only 10% restoration have been done which explains the low walls weathered down by the natural elements. Never regretted.

Amazing Experience... Be ready to climb a bit... Has a little climb from the Cable to the Great Wall ... Suggestion to visit during the off-season to have the spot and village down below for all yourself!!!

After visiting Badaling Great Wall last year, we went to Simatai this year. There is less to walk at Simatai, but the benefit is that the wall opens until the evening, meaning that you can witness an amazing sunset here. After sunset they turn the lights on which creates a magical atmosphere. Make sure to queue around 5PM to go up from the Watertown, as it is really busy. From the cable car it takes about 15 minutes walking to the actual wall.

Great experience to visit the place. Wonder how our ancestors managed to build such a huge structure during the time when machinery was not available. We did the claim in the morning and took a cable car again to go up the Great Wall in the evening to catch the sunset view. Get ready a comfortable walking shoes, tracking wear, water and even cap if u are visiting the place.

Worth the 3 hours drive from Beijing. Area is so scenic especially the Gubei Watertown. The climb to the watchtower can be challenging in parts for seniors who don’t exercise much. We took the cable car up and down so that saves us time and energy. The view up at the watchtower is spectacular, with cool air and we were fortunate to experience sunny weather during our visit.

It does not get better than this. Less crowded, stunning, and the nearby Watertown is delightful. I would advise taking cable car one way up around 3pm, they will push you to start heading down by 430, but this allows u the perfect sunset view. Do not buy round-trip cable car if u want to see the sunset. It's easy coming down by hike. Don't miss this. Best stretch of great wall, better than badaling and mutianyu and much less crowded.

Nice little town with a light cool breeze. The cable ride up to the Wall was smooth and got a spectacular view of the entire mountain. You will need to walk a short distance to start the Great Wall walk. There are many stations or towers that you can stop to take a rest. Overall, it's a lifetime experience to experience this memorable walk.

According to tourism info, this is one of the great wall with very minimal restoration/renovation that open to public. Which mean you get the see the very original view of the great wall. There is different ticket for the night entry, and there is cable car which bring you up close to the tower 8. But we were told the best is hiking up, then only going down with the cable car. So we hiked up and the view is magnificent. PS, Dec 2019, less crowded compared with other season.

A very beautiful section of the Great Wall with original unrestored walls. It was a bit of a drive for us, but it was worth it. Patches of snow in winter added a poetic feel. I recommend visiting now before it becomes too touristy.

It was not crowded as we went early on a weekdays. Strongly recommended to take the cable car up to the hilltop and then experience walking the Great Wall. There are 10 Towers and it will be impossible to complete all in a single day. Overall, it's worth the trip from Beijing.

Visited in a large group of 18 - 3 generations of family, with ages spanning 6 years to 76 years! Everyone in our group found it enjoyable and accomplishing! Staff were friendly and helpful. As we ascended in the late evening, they checked in with us and made sure our party made it safely back to the cable station before restarting the system to ride down.

The nightview of the watertown from the Greatwall is beautiful Suggest to take the cablecar up before 5pm The 500m walk from the cablecar station to the Greatwall is narrow This part of the Greatwall is ideal for hiking

Afternoon time around 4 pm is the best for visiting this great wall. You may take a bit climb up. There is a beautiful scenic spot. You will witness beauty of town and lake as well. You may stay there until the sunset and then return back. After the sunset, town lighting will give you another unforgettable look. I have few representative pictures which I am sharing with you here.

Nice tourist place in simatai. You can enjoy the scenery here. Its gorgeous place. There are few hotels if you want to spend a night in this brautiful place. Has good peking duck restaurant too. Then you can go climb the great wall here. You can use the cable car if you are too tired to climb.

It was an awesome and satisfying experience. Some parts were steep. Recommended to take a 2-way cable car, which brings you to midway, hike all the way to station 10 and then back to station 5 to take the cable car down.

Simatai is a beautiful section of the Great Wall located 2 hours away by car from Beijing city proper. Avoid the Gubei Water Town if you are not keen on it and head straight for the ropeway to that takes you to Simatai and slowly take time to enjoy the little hike and the beautiful scenery. If coming only for the night view, which is spectacular, then leave Beijing city about 1600 depending on traffic. Can have dinner at the many shops and restaurants at Gubei Water Town, ride the ropeway at about 1900, and enjoy the breathtaking night scene.

A beautiful section of the wall which takes approximately two hours to walk if you are going from the cable car up then down the walk way back to Gubei. We found that this part of the wall was not very busy at all, and some sections we had to ourselves to take lots of pictures. This may be because we went at an off peak time. It is a very long section of the wall and can be quite physically demanding. The views from the wall are gorgeous and it's great to see the immensity of it all.

Was there mid of December, it was cold. In my opinion it was a great time to go. There was hardly anyone there and we had the place to ourselves. Some mistakes I see people do is wear sports shoes. Don't do this, you will suffer. Wear leather hiking shoes/ boots. If it's waterproof it's good because of water cannot get thru, cold wind won't. Sport shoes are breathable, if air can escape, cold air can go into too. I saw many putting heat packs into their shoes. Some ladies were stuck at the foot of the wall not being able to climb it co's they were in heels. Think hiking when going here, on the other hand don't over insulate .. the wall is steep and it will take effort to climb. Your body will heat up as you 'exercise'.

Not completely off the tracks, but there are way less tourists in Simatai than for instance in Badaling, which is closer to Beijing. The wall is illuminated by lights at night, which is a beautiful experience and unique to Simatai to my best knowledge. The same is true for the romantic village at the foot of the mountains.

Been to the Great Wall several times in different locations, this is definitely my favorite. Not busy at all and has a mix of original wall and restored parts. Great views of the mountain rangers on this hike.

Beautiful old style Chinese village with luxury accommodations and a breathtaking view on the Simatai Great Wall. Although not an original old watertown (everything is brand new), it is very beautiful and worth going. Most rooms are fitted with floor heating and the tab water is drinkable allegedly.

We had a wonderful time visiting the Simatai Great Wall with our family, and the awe-inspiring grandeur of this ancient marvel is truly unforgettable. One drawback we encountered is the inability to use cash within the tourist area. This poses a significant inconvenience, especially for foreign visitors who do not have access to WeChat Pay, as it prevents them from purchasing souvenirs or dining at local restaurants. However, thanks to the kindness of the Chinese locals, we were able to exchange cash and they graciously facilitated payments through WeChat Pay, allowing us to enjoy our evening meals. Furthermore, we were disappointed by the lack of friendliness and English proficiency among the staff working there. Despite being a popular tourist destination, the fact that not a single staff member could speak a word of English left us feeling somewhat disappointed. Looking ahead, we believe that enabling cash payments and deploying English-speaking staff would greatly enhance the experience for the countless foreign tourists who visit attractions like the Great Wall and the beautifully crafted Gubei Water Town. It would not only improve the perception of China but also make the visit more accessible and enjoyable for international visitors.
Can not say enough about this place. So beautiful. The views are incredible. Very clean, was not crowded.

Worthed every minute of drive from Beijing as there is almost no people. You can really enjoy the wall. If you want to walk up you should have a lot of energy as it gets really steep. We've done it in the downwards direction and it was great.
Beautiful walk. It's only start of early spring..i am sure it would be fascinating when the cherry blossom starting full blooms.
Finally I have been here. 1 of 7 wonders of the world. Just amazing view from this place. From Gubei Water Town you can hike with cable car or using usual track.

Awesome views. Even though it rained at the start of the climb, it was still an amazing experience. Compared to the hordes of tourists at Badaling in pictures I've seen, there were few other people at this section of the wall (although, maybe the rain helped to keep some away). Some parts are steep, so wear good, grippy shoes.
It's such a wonderful place! We were here the first week of March, and the wall and Gube Watertown were totally without tourists.

How to visit the Great Wall of China Simatai… I’m writing this review because there wasn’t much information online about visiting this part of the wall and it’s such a beautiful area to see it. 1. Getting there You can take the bus or hire a taxi/private car for the day. We went to our hotel and they organised a private car. 9 hours for ¥900. I personally think that’s reasonable as it’s about 1hr40mins away from Beijing city. We left at 10:30am and arrived around 12:10pm to the wall. They driver dropped us off at the Shuizhen Hotel right by the Water Town and we could walk to the ticketing area and the rest of the town. It’s about 2 min walk from the hotel to the ticketing area. 2. The Town/ Ticketing The Water town is a separate area and you need to book tickets to view it. I didn’t do that so I don’t know too much about it. The town where my driver dropped is off is right next to the water town. There are a lot of restaurants to eat at, there’s a Starbucks and also some convenient stores (named Lawsons) if you want to buy snacks etc. Once you’re in the town just walk straight across the bride and you will find a building called ‘The Great Wall Simatai Ticketing Information’. Inside you can buy your tickets for entrance, the cable car and also you wait there for a shuttle to take you to the wall. You can also prebook your tickets using WeChat. I just searched the Great Wall of China Simatai and then followed the steps to book my tickets. The entrance is ¥40 and then you can pay for a cable car as well. One way with entrance fee is ¥110 and return cable car with entrance is ¥180 3. Climbing the wall The shuttle only comes as certain times to take you to the base of the wall or the cable car. Keep in mind, if it is windy the cable car will be closed as it’s dangerous (this was the case for us) so you are forced to walk up and down. We got a refund for our cable car but I don’t know if that’s always the case. Once you book the tickets you wait in the ticketing building and then take a shuttle bus. Our shuttle came at 1pm. You will need to check online for the times of the shuttle, it’s usually every hour or so. The drive to the base of the wall is about 6 mins. From the base you will need to walk to the first tower. There are 10 towers you will pass along the wall. The walk to the first tower is about 30 mins and then you go up along the wall. My friends and I took 1 hours to walk from the 1st to the 10th tower. We’re in our 20’s and reasonably fit so keep that in mind, it may take a little longer for others. There are steep sections and if it’s windy it can be extra cold on the wall. Coming down the wall takes a little less time but make sure you are back at the very base by 4:30 for the last shuttle if you are planing on walking back down. I had a really good time, it is such a beautiful area to view. If I could have taken the cable car I recommend taking the cable car up and then walking down. The shuttle back to town is free and the views are better walking down as you can see the whole wall as you walk.
Scenic view on the Great Walll. Friendly staffs but none of them speak basic English. Translator tools are needed.
If you like to avoid crowded, Simatai Great Wall is a great place to explore where less tourist spot. You can enjoy to take photo as can as you want with great looking view with empty people.
Nice location with rough structure, but makes it feel original like it was in the past. Only very difficult to get there from Beijing when you do not book a guided tour.
peaceful place, some parts of the wall very well preserved some others not as much. easy walk only a few spots with signs to advert of the risk of falling
Much less visitors, but even more spectacular view than other part of Great Wall.
If you want see, experience, walk on the Great wall fo China then this is the place. It is a bit of a drive from downtown Beijing but so worth it!
Not as crowded and a little rough around the edges. Steep at times so not for everyone. The Water Village nearby is lovely too.
Worth the 2 hour trip from Beijing. A scarey climb in some places, unforgettable

領隊導遊都會說這裡沒有整修，但實際上還是有修過，只是沒有修得那麼誇張，還是保有損壞的部分。這段長城興建在山脊上，從古北水振望上去，會覺得古人竟然可以在這樣的地方興建長城，真的很厲害。體力和時間都比較不足，建議跟我一樣搭纜車往返。纜車下車後還要走上十幾分鐘，個人建議在岔路時先走右邊往上到東八，沿著長城走到目前開放的東十後折返。東八到東九非常陡，樓梯樹非常多，如果自認體力不佳，那就放棄往上，直接往下走到東五，因為東五走回纜車站是需要上坡的。體力好時間多的，可以搭纜車上山，東八走到東十後折返，一路走下山，大概要一兩個鐘頭以上，看個人體力狀況。不建議夏天到訪，因為我走到快晒乾了。據說壯麗的敵樓是東十五十六，但沒有開放，實在可惜

[25.11.20] 베이징 여행 베이징 근교 고북수진에 인접한 만리장성의 한 구간입니다. 만리장성 중 유일하게 야간 개방을 하는 장성으로 알려져 있어서, 야경의 만리장성을 볼 수 있었습니다. 밤에 불빛이 들어온 장성의 모습은 정말 색다르고 좋았습니다. 낮과는 또 다른 웅장함과 아름다움이 느껴져요. 장성에 올라갈때 생각보다 숨이 많이 차긴 합니다. 경사가 가파른 구간도 있어서 체력 소모가 꽤 있어요. 하지만 여기까지 만리장성을 보러 왔으면, 힘들어도 올라가 봐야죠. 고북수진 투어와 함께 야경을 볼 수 있다는 점이 가장 큰 장점이라고 생각합니다.
司馬台長城號稱「原始長城」，有奇、險、密、全、巧五大美，在北京近郊密雲區，通常連「北古水鎮」旅遊渡假區一起遊覧。 建議從遊客中心乘電瓶車節省腳力，直接去到纜車站登山，回程下山再漫步欣賞「北古水鎮」風光。 登上山由纜車出來，沿指示向前走，約15-20分鐘，先到5、6號「敵樓」打卡，全程石板路，上下階級不多，老幼咸宜。再由6號「敵樓」向7、8號進發，然後下去纜車站下山，比較陡峭，就要量力而為。
Wielki Mur Chiński to niekończąca się ilość schodów do pokonania. Wspaniałe widoki. Warto zobaczyć!
Bellissimo e super consigliato, parte della muraglia antica poco ristrutturata, con pochissimi turisti, spettacolare per i tramonti, si raggiunge con cabinovia e un piccolo trekking
Отличная точка для подъема на стену, интереснее ютаньмунь Лучше останавливаться с ночёвкой в water town и с утра подниматься, меньше людей и солнышко греет

แนะนำถ้ามาเองมาพักสักคืนที่เมืองโบราณกู๊เป่ยนะคะ และช่วงเวลาที่ดีในการขึ้นมาคือในรอบเย็น ตอนประมาณตั้งแต่เวลา 17.00 น. เป็นต้นไป เราจะได้เห็นพระอาทิตย์ตกดิน ถ้าต้องการความสะดวกสบายเพิ่มขึ้นแนะนำให้ใช้กระเช้าขึ้นลงนะคะส่วนทางด้านห้องน้ำสะดวกสบายมีทั้ง สถานีกระเช้า ด้านล่างและด้านบนค่ะ

2023-May-5 : Tickets for day tour of Simatai Great Wall can be purchased at the main entrance. By 16:30 the Great Wall will be cleared. Enter via Gubei Water Town to visit the night-Simatai Great Wall. Purchase tickets at the Service Center's counter of Gubei Water Town with passport. Adult entry fee ¥280 (entry to water town, the night Great Wall & round-trip cableway). Note the ticket is for single entry only. Earliest entry to night-Great Wall at 18:30. The street light of the town turn on at 19:00. 司马台长城 白天游长城门票可在入口购买。16:30 长城清场。 游夜长城须进入古北水镇。入门票须在 古北水镇服务中心用护照在柜台购票。¥280 包括水镇进入，夜长城与来回索道。门票只能一次进入，白天如果进出晚上就不能用了。夜长城 18:30 开始进入。水镇街道 19:00 开灯。

A wonderful place to admire the Great Wall, in a spectacular section, at the top of sharp mountains. There is also the beautiful watertown of Gubei, which is quite interesting to visit. However, I only put 4 stars as the Simatai section is mostly closed to the public due to security reasons. Hence the stroll on the Great Wall ends up being quite short. I was a bit disappointed. Un lieu sublime pour admirer la grande muraille, dans une section spectaculaire, le long de crêtes de montagne escarpées. Il y a aussi la vieille ville de Gubei, le long d'une petite rivière, qui est intéressante. Cependant, je ne mets pas 5 car la section de Simatai est en grande partie fermée au public pour des raisons de sécurité - la ballade sur la muraille tourne donc assez court.
팔달령과는 다르게 미완성된것같은 풍경이 더 좋았음. 사람 많을땐 위험하지만 없을때, 그것도 날씨 좋을때 가면 역대급 사진을 얻을수있음 고북수진과 세트로 투어로 갔다왔음 쓰레기통이 많고 가는길이 깨끗함 장성 중간중간에 안전요원이 많이 배치되어있어 안전함
아침 일찍 첫 케이블카를 타고 올라 가서 사람들이 전혀 없어서 너무 좋았어요. 케이블카에서 내려 조금 걷다 보면 두개 길로 갈리는데 5호 망루쪽 내려 가는길 강추. 6호 망루에서 7호 망루 올라 가는 길이 뷰도 좋고 제일 멋짐.

Najpiekniejsze wejście na mur chiński. Miasteczko cudowne, stylizowane na starą epokę. Polecam zejść pieszo widoki piękne i można poczuć klimat. Dojechać z Pekinu można autobusem 980, Chińczycy bardzo pomocni i ciekawi nas i naszych zachowań...można zostać bohaterem gdy się ustąpi miejsca w autobusie osobie starszej...😁😊
為中國長城最險峻的一段，是唯一保存良好的明代長城，1987年被聯合國列入「世界遺產」全長5.4公里,被鴛鴦湖分為東西兩段，目前開放東1樓至東10樓(敵樓)。一路上上下下相當陡峭，現架有索道車從入口處至長城8樓處往返。
Simatai , najbardziej dziki odcinek muru Chińskiego, fajne widoki, piękny na zachód słonca ,w nocy pięknie oświetlony i ładny widok z miasteczka.

Cách xa trung tâm BK, nên ai đi đến Simatai thì nên ở Thủy Bắc Cổ Trấn ít nhất 1 đêm Do xa trung tâm nên nơi đây khá vắng, trong lành, và vẫn còn nét cổ từ xưa, do chưa dc trùng tu nhiều như Bát Đạt Lĩnh

"Das Ziel bietet wenig Touristen und ist daher nicht überlaufen. Es kann entweder zu Fuß erklommen werden oder man nutzt die Seilbahn und muss nur noch ein kleines Stück laufen. Die Wasserstadt war auch schön anzuschauen und erinnerte an Venedig. Es gab viele kleine Shoppingmöglichkeiten und ausreichend Essensmöglichkeiten. Der Eintritt ist angemessen und nicht überteuert. Ein Besuch hier ist einer der besten Möglichkeiten, um die chinesische Mauer zu erleben."
我們是徒步上到第七樓，一路上非常壯觀讚嘆古人如此厲害! 爬到第六七樓會有點害怕，因為圍牆非常矮站在中間視覺就會看到懸崖邊，深怕自己一個不注意掉下去，但其實是不會的! 爬過一次後深深愛上這裡!太美了。

Всі мають хоч раз побачити Велику китайську стіну. А це найкраща місце для цього! Ще не реконструйована стіна. Багато туристичних атракцій, є підйомник, підтримка гіда. Добратися можна від автовокзалу Донджемен. Дуже рекомендую відвідати стіну саме тут.

Schitterende omgeving met mooie uitzichten vanaf de muur en de torens. Alles is nog origineel. Het dorpje Gubei is ook heel pittoresk met mooie lichtjes 's-anonds en mooir uitzichten op verlichte muur.

` กำแพงเมืองจีนเป็นสถานที่ท่องเที่ยวที่น่าสนใจและมีความหมายทางประวัติศาสตร์อย่างลึกซึ้ง กำแพงเมืองจีนมีความยาวประมาณ 21,000 กิโลเมตร และเป็นกำแพงที่ยาวที่สุดในโลก กำแพงเมืองจีนถูกสร้างขึ้นเพื่อป้องกันการบุกรุกของชนเผ่าต่างๆ และเป็นสัญลักษณ์ของอำนาจและความภูมิใจของชาติจีน การเดินทางไปดูกำแพงเมืองจีนจะให้ประสบการณ์ที่ไม่เหมือนใคร ไม่ว่าจะเป็นการชื่นชมความงดงามของสถาปัตยกรรม การสัมผัสถึงประวัติศาสตร์ที่ยาวนาน หรือการท้าทายตัวเองด้วยการปีนขึ้นไปบนกำแพง เพื่อชมวิวที่สวยงามของธรรมชาติ
Satu pengembaraan yang menakjubkan,datanglah sekali seumur hidup utk melihat salah satu 7keajaiban dunia yang masih ada,setelah ribuan tahun dibina

偶然的在一次觀看FB貼文時看到一篇文章在介紹古北水鎮景區及司馬台長城的秋景, 當下就花了些時間拜讀完整篇介紹, 自此對這個景點就出在心中留下一個深刻印象, 平常整年都忙於工作根本沒太多時間安排旅遊, 後來難得在年底空出了一點時間便順勢安排了一次北京旅遊, 雖然錯過心心念念的秋景但是來看看冬景也還是不錯. 第三天一大早從北京出發來到古北水鎮景區約兩個多小時, 從停車場下車往景區門口走的路上有整個景區的地圖, 果然景區範圍相當大, 走在橋上看著小河面上結了一層好白的冰, 這對居住在不下雪的地方的我來說非常新奇, 順便也抓了一小把樹下的積雪真的凍到精神都來了, 在景區買好了門票就往纜車站前進準備上長城, 坐在纜車上快速上攀的過程長城越來越大, 出了纜車站上到長城往下俯瞰整個古北水鎮還伴隨山坡上的積雪真是美, 接著開始在長城上開心的走著, 經過了敵樓或是烽火台, 透過小窗向外眺望感受不同視覺的震撼, 不過身處在長城上這冬日的寒風不斷往身上掃過真的感覺衣服穿再多都不夠, 幸好長城上沒有太多積雪不然面對部份陡峭的路面肯定更難移動, 整體的風景相當壯麗, 站在長城上遠眺的範圍非常開闊而且可以看得非常遠, 期待有機會下次再訪可以賞秋景.
